title: A property-registry contract for retrieve-or-refuse thermal-mechanical lattice search
abstract: arXiv:2609.14741v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Early thermal-mechanical lattice requirements are knowledge-intensive and often jointly unsatisfiable: an engineer asks for a cell that is light, stiff, laterally conducting and cheap, and no cell in the library satisfies it. A design system should say so, and say which requirement to loosen and by how much, rather than return the nearest row. A generative model can return a candidate even when the library holds none. This work applies established conflict diagnosis to a catalogue of homogenised properties. Search over 1,397 homogenised unit cells and 19 base materials (26,543 combinations) returns a catalogue row that a second solver can rebuild, or, for an empty feasible set of at most eight constraints, inclusion-minimal unsatisfiable subsets (MUS) and the slack of a repair, not a neighbour. One registry declaration generates the prompt and the evaluator, so undeclared parsed keys cannot reach search. On a frozen suite of 64 typed q

translated_title: 面向检索或拒绝式热-力学点阵搜索的属性注册表契约
translated_abstract: 早期的热-力学点阵设计需求是知识密集型的，且常常无法同时满足：工程师要求一个轻质、高刚度、横向导热且廉价的晶胞，但库中没有任何晶胞能同时满足这些要求。此时设计系统应当如实说明这一点，并指出应放宽哪项需求、放宽多少，而不是返回最接近的条目。生成式模型即使在库中无可用候选时也会返回一个候选。本工作将成熟的冲突诊断方法应用于均质化属性目录。对1,397个均质化单胞和19种基体材料（共26,543种组合）的搜索，要么返回一个可供第二求解器重建的目录行；要么当至多八个约束构成空可行集时，返回包含最小的不可满足子集（MUS）以及修复方案的松弛量，而不是返回邻近项。仅一条注册表声明即可同时生成提示词和评估器，因此未经声明的解析键无法进入搜索流程。在冻结的64个带类型q……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种属性注册表契约机制，使热-力学点阵搜索要么返回可供第二求解器重建验证的目录行，要么在需求联合不可满足时给出最小不可满足子集（MUS）与修复松弛量，而非返回最邻近的替代结果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a property-registry contract for retrieve-or-refuse thermal-mechanical lattice search, which either returns a solver-rebuildable catalogue row or, when requirements are jointly unsatisfiable, reports inclusion-minimal unsatisfiable subsets (MUS) and repair slack instead of the nearest neighbor.
